findings.reason: a reader following §8 to the audit's parse route lands on §12, which excludes it, so the plan's own routing sends them to the node that does not carry the fix.
findings.text: §8 states "The audit walks and parses by its own route, which is §12", but after the §12/§13 split §12 carries only the walk and its deliverable explicitly defers the parse ("Sharing §11's parse in `_audit_plan_state` is §13"); the pointer therefore names the wrong node for half the route it describes

findings.reason: the deliverable's explicit deferral and the walk-only done-when leave the node's scope unambiguous, so only the heading and filename are stale, not the work.
findings.text: §12's heading ("The audit walks and parses through the shared scan and parse") and its declared test filename (line 159, `tests/test_the_audit_shares_the_scan_and_parse.py`) both advertise a parse the section no longer delivers, so the unit reads as two deliverables while its body delivers one

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §8's cross-reference names §12 for the audit's parse, which after the split now lives in §13.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §12 declares a countable measure (walked once) plus an equal-findings measure, each with its own negative control (revert the rglob walk; drop invalid files without recording), so both halves of the deliverable can be shown to fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both negative-control logs are declared "under the run directory", a durable path in the crew report tree, not a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §12 carries no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags, and no changelog prose into code.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause (`sorted(docs_dir.rglob("*.html"))` at reckon/mcp.py:2355 and `_audit_plan_state` → `_plan_html.from_html` at mcp.py:2265) matches §7's finding, the mechanism (open one `resource_scan_scope`, take resources from `iter_resources`, have the scan record dropped files) can produce the one-walk and equal-findings measures, and the mechanism runs on the real `_audit` path whose production caller is named.
rubric_items.single_goal: a finding — §12's heading and its declared test filename both assert a parse that the section's own deliverable assigns to §13.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §12 is named in the sole open followup f-araiid-009 (whose body routes §8, §11, §10, §12, §13 and §6), and §12's stated order ("runs after §8 and §10") matches the followup's ordering.
